error[ZBX-E0424]: a file name in the store has too many links
  while  building the directory a container runs on
  cause  the file system refused another hard link to an object: too many links
         (EMLINK)
  path   /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/store
  fix    keep fewer copies of that file in use, or move the store to a file system with a higher limit
  more   zbx explain E0424
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0424.html
